title: Joomla Extension - php-web-design.com - CSRF for various actions in StageIt 1.0-5.7.5, 6.0-6.3.5 (CVE-2026-103420)
description: A Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability exists in the Joomla extension php-web-design.com StageIt versions 1.0 through 5.7.5 and 6.0 through 6.3.5. This vulnerability allows unauthorized actions to be performed via CSRF attacks.
